title: Requirements file that disables binary wheels globally
description: requirements.txt declares a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
limitation: It matches a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
